part.text: Fixed. In `handleHTTPRequest` (gin.go:693), `make([]string, 0, len(t)-1)` allocated a negative capacity when the engine had no route trees (`len(t) == 0`), causing the `makeslice: cap out of range` panic. Changed it to `make([]string, 0, len(t))`; the exact capacity isn't needed since `allowed` only grows via append. Full test suite passes.
